description: Create consistent cite keys from the first author's family name, the year and the first meaningful word of the title, like smith2024deep. Repeated keys get a letter added. Returns the old and new key for each entry and the list as BibTeX with the new keys. Example: an entry with key old1, author "Smith, John", year 2024 and title "Deep Learning for Graphs" gives old_key old1 and new_key smith2024deep, or smith2024 when include_title_word is false.

format.description: The format of the text. Defaults to auto, which looks at the text to decide.

include_title_word.description: Add the first meaningful title word, so you get smith2024deep and not smith2024. Defaults to true.

text.description: The reference list as text: BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON.

name: generate_cite_keys

bibtex.description: The list as BibTeX using the new keys.

title: Generate cite keys
